verdict.rationale: AWS documents a Free plan for new accounts: $100 in credits immediately plus up to $100 more earned, totalling up to $200 over 6 months. There are no charges unless the user converts to a Paid plan, so the credit limit and the expiry window are both spelled out. A community comment corroborates a free egress allowance (95GB). Missing for 10: documented per-service always-free tier limits, published startup-specific credit programs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the credit terms.

support.subject: As a founder, starting is free — an always-free tier and/or published startup credits with the limits and expiry spelled out

citations.quote: That's up to $200 over 6 months to build, break things, and experiment with no charges and no surprise bills on the Free plan.
When you create a new AWS Free Tier account, you get $100 in credits immediately. As you explore key services, you can earn up to $100 more.
You won't be charged unless you convert to a Paid plan.
